name: commercegears/module-smtp
description: SMTP for Magento 2: send store emails through Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 (OAuth 2.0), Amazon SES, SendGrid, Mailgun, Brevo, Postmark or any SMTP server, with an email log, resend, retries, a staging safety switch and DNS checks.

suggest.commercegears/module-admin-activity-log: Records who changed the SMTP settings
suggest.commercegears/module-cron-manager: Shows when the email queue and log clean-up jobs last ran
